canonCard.title: Standard SaaS Dashboard
canonCard.thesis: The category standard: a generic SaaS dashboard.
canonCard.palette: Light gray background, white cards, blue primary buttons, green/red status pills.
canonCard.materials: Rounded corners, drop shadows, repetitive icon boxes, standard system fonts.
canonCard.firstViewport: A side navigation panel, a top header with search and profile, and a main content area filled with statistic cards and a basic data table.
canonCard.honestRisk: Familiar but exactly what the brief asked to avoid. It will not feel premium or human-designed.

options.title: The Exhibition Catalog
options.thesis: Treats each candidate like a curated work. Expansive whitespace, elegant typography, and a restrained focus on individual merit, refusing the noisy, metric-heavy SaaS dashboard.
options.palette: Achromatic text fields (pure white and deep black) with color confined strictly to hairline band edges for status (derived from Cloud Edge).
options.materials: Sharp edges, crisp subtle borders, no shadows. Information is structured in clean tables and tight editorial columns. Scores use a fixed magnitude ramp for visual weight (derived from Star Atlas).
options.firstViewport: A stripped-back, focused table of uploaded resumes. Selecting a candidate opens a pristine, full-height review panel with comfortable reading measures, akin to an exhibition catalog entry.
options.honestRisk: The high contrast and lack of typical UI affordances (cards, pills) might require a brief adjustment period for users accustomed to standard SaaS tools.
